messages:
Jordan: Quick proposal — tweak our weekly triage cadence. Move to a 45m slot: 30m backlog/bug triage + 15m short 'deep-dive' for one RFC/design. Rotate the triage owner every 2 weeks instead of weekly. Thoughts?
Sam: +1 to rotation slowdown, weekly switches are churn heavy. 2 weeks gives context. :thumbsup:
Lee: Prefer 30m total if we can. 45m often collides with other syncs for the team. Could we keep 30m but add an optional 15m deep-dive that only happens when needed?
Jordan: Good call. My goal is to get predictable owner coverage and a reliable slot for one focused review. So option A: 45m weekly (always). Option B: 30m core + optional 15m deep-dive when requested (ad-hoc). Which do folks prefer?
Maya: I can coordinate calendar invites either way. Quick question: where do we post the pre-read/triage list? #eng-triage or Confluence?
Natalie: Please post a short pre-read in #eng on Monday morning — just 3 bullets: top bugs, top backlog tickets, and the RFC for deep-dive. If we keep it to 30m core + optional deep-dive, we should set a cutoff for deep-dive requests (Weds EOD?).
Sam: +1 to Monday pre-read. Cutoff Thurs EOD for requesting the deep-dive, so owners have time. Also timezone note — our EU folks struggle with early PST meetings. Can we shift window to 16:00 PST / 00:00 UTC or keep at 09:00 PST?
Jordan: Timezones suck. Proposal: keep current time (09:00 PST) but rotate the deep-dive slot every other week to a later time for one week per month so EU can attend occasionally. Not ideal but flexible.
Lee: If we're doing rotation, let's auto-assign backups for each owner week so urgent stuff still gets handled. Backup = oncall-ish person for that week.
Maya: I'll add a simple agenda template to the calendar description and create a rotating invite using Google Calendar (owner + backup). Template: 
```
- 10m: critical bug review (priority, owner)
- 10m: backlog triage (next actions)
- 10m: rollouts / infra notes / quick blockers
- 15m (optional): RFC/design deep-dive (pre-registered)
```
Jordan: Perfect. Also propose we add a one-line 'pretriage digest' pinned in #eng on Monday so people can skim. Maya, can you handle the first two weeks of owner rotation while we test?
Maya: Yup I can do the first two. Will post Monday digest and update calendar.
Natalie: For owner assignment, suggest this algorithm: owners pick from a rotating list; if someone is OOO, they get skipped and backup steps in. I'll make a tiny sheet to track rotation and OOO blocks.
Sam: Can we add a short async checklist for owners (2 bullets) in the calendar invite? e.g., 'post pre-read by Monday, confirm backup by Wednesday'.
Maya: Will add that in the invite and in the pinned digest.
ops-bot: Reminder: next scheduled triage Thu 09:00 PST. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/triage
Jordan: Cool — plan: Maya sets up rotation + calendar this afternoon, Natalie builds rotation sheet, we run 2-week pilot and reconvene for feedback. If anyone wants to propose alternate schedule, drop it here by EOD. :eyes:
Sam: Sounds good. Thanks Maya + Natalie.
Lee: If pilot shows too many no-shows we revert to weekly but keep the 15m deep-dive ad-hoc.
Maya: Invite created, rotation started, posted Monday digest draft in #eng. I'll DM owners to confirm backups. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: Awesome. Thanks everyone.
Sam: :thumbsup:
Natalie: :raised_hands:
